title: Command palette usability

phases.label: Web-first intake
phases.bottleneck_notes: Official accessibility and search UX references checked before local planning.

phases.label: Memory bootstrap and local context
phases.bottleneck_notes: Hot anchors came from current AGENTS instructions, recent platform-desktop-app records, and active source context.

phases.label: Requirements, spec, and plan
phases.bottleneck_notes: Requirement, spec, plan, tasks, validation, and traceability records created.

phases.label: Implementation
phases.bottleneck_notes: Command palette result status, recommendations, empty state, CSS, and tests added.

phases.label: Verification
phases.bottleneck_notes: Renderer check/test/build, platform check, Browser smoke, server cleanup, and guard records completed.

phases.label: Evaluation, commit, and push
phases.bottleneck_notes: Evaluation records, staging, commit, and push are handled in the final close-out pass.

bottleneck_notes: Most visible time cost is production build and Browser smoke rather than the code edit itself.
